author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Fine Alpha Sweep (2/N): alpha=0.08
abstract:
This is the second run in my fine-grained sweep for `correction_alpha`. The peak performance
was observed at alpha=0.1 (score 0.7444). This run tests a slightly lower value, alpha=0.08,
to see if the true optimum is in the range (0.01, 0.1).

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_gene_correction_v2 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as gene_correction_v2_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Fine Alpha Sweep Run 2: Test alpha = 0.08
  return gene_correction_v2_fn(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.65, 
        delta=0.04, 
        kdensity=18, 
        k_total=50,
        correction_alpha=0.08,
        rng_seed=1
    )
